source: Two independent agent reviews of each hero's current ability text (data/catalog/heroes.json), 28 heroes each, starting from the keyword-rule tags; maintainer asked for every hero to be checked after Lt. Belica was missing burst.
note: Up to 3 role tags per hero, most defining first. tank and diver shown on the page always come from engine/src/team-comp.ts tagHero (class + kit-profile dive), so tags match the draft shape counts; a reviewer's tank/diver choice here is advisory. ROLE_TAG_OVERRIDES in team-comp.ts (maintainer rulings) are added on top.

adele.reason: Warden who opens with Imperial Lash (dash + root) or Queen's Garden (leap, interrupt, root, slowing Thornbush) and adds Royal Flourish's Mesmerize, so three hard-CC abilities plus a zone make her control; swapped peel for control since she has no ally shield or heal.

akeron.reason: Crushing Maw and Consume heal him and Pact of the Devourer's Awakened mitigation wins long brawls, Web Lash's lash-leap knockup/stun starts fights, and Consume's pull-and-execute closes one-on-ones; replaced control with engage and duelist since his CC is a single engage tool, not zone control.

argus.reason: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull, Dread Nova stuns, and Synaptic Obliterator fires terrain-piercing long-range beams with Particle Shredder homing chip; current control, poke kept.

aurora.reason: Tank whose Glacial Charge dash and Cryoseism AoE slow-into-stun open fights, with Hoarfrost root ring and Boreal Sweep slows adding area lockdown; current tags kept.

bayle.reason: Skull Crusher leap and Kingslayer dash-uppercut put him on a target, Kingslayer's max-health strikes and Berserk's low-health attack speed win one-on-ones, and Dire Howl's omnivamp plus delayed heal sustains him; added duelist.

boris.reason: Detection Protocol tracks and Ursine Burst dash-grabs a target out of position, then Tesseract Device's on-hit attack speed, zaps and healing win the extended fight with Primeval Roar's damage reduction and fear; replaced burst with duelist since his damage is sustained on-hit, not a one-shot combo.

countess.reason: Feast leaps to and suppresses a hero for max-health damage with Haemorrhage bonus damage, Shadow Slip dashes in and swaps back out, and Blade Siphon plus Feast's Haemorrhage lifesteal heal her through fights; added sustain.

crunch.reason: Forward Crunch dashes in with a stun (Turbo range is huge), Cross Crunch empowered basics with cooldown cuts and Turbo Right Crunch's knockup win skirmishes, and Re-Crunch's passive heals every third hit; added duelist.

dekker.reason: Stasis Bomb and Ion Strike stuns plus Containment Fence walling heroes in or out protect carries and lock fights; current peel, control kept.

drongo.reason: Marksman who kites with Old Rusty boomerang and Gag Grenade from range while Rad Rounds and Wastelander max-health bleed deal sustained damage; current poke, dps kept.

eden.reason: Stance carry whose Nova Repeater/Plasma Claws, Tachyon Lance and Overheat-gated Limit Break deliver sustained fight-long damage; current dps kept (Zero Shift's melee-stance heal is a stance perk, not her identity).

feng-mao.reason: Reaping Dash blinks in for current-health damage and Earth Shatter executes with a free recast, while Safeguard's spellshield and Hamstring's single-target bonus damage win one-on-ones; added duelist.

gadget.reason: Tesla Dome and Seek and Destroy zone areas and Security Gate roots, while the airborne drone and Sticky Mine chip enemies from range before fights; added poke.

gideon.reason: Black Hole pulls a clumped team in and Cosmic Rift plus Void Breach and the Cosmic Power tether-root deliver area burst; current control, burst kept.

greystone.reason: Assault The Gates leaps a long way in, Stone Forged Soul heals up to a multiple based on missing health, and Stoicism's deflect, regen and armor scaling with missing health make him win drawn-out skirmishes; added duelist.

grim-exe.reason: Assault Mode turns The Inverter into long-range cleaving basics with Pulsefire bonus damage for sustained output, and GTFO's terrain-passing homing orb plus lobbed Displacement Blast chip from range; added poke.

grux.reason: Maintainer ruling 2026-11-08: Grux is a diver. Smash 'n Grab pulls and stuns, Stampede dashes and drags heroes, and Warlord's Challenge AoE stuns, then Bloodlust bleed stacks, Warlord's power steal and Double Pain's missing-health heal win brawls; dropped diver (he drags enemies to him rather than jumping the backline) and added duelist.

howitzer.reason: Land Mine stuns and Cluster Grenades slow to lock down space while the charged R2000 Missile and Make It Rain barrages hit from long range; added poke.

iggy-scorch.reason: Molotov fire fields, Oil Spill trails and up to three Flame Turrets deny an area, and the turrets plus Badlands Critter Ignite and Inferno burn steadily over the whole fight; added dps.

ikra.reason: Hydroclasm bubbles popped by Brine chip from range, Narcosis suspends a hero and Genesis knocks up through walls into a burst follow-up; added control for the two hard-CC abilities and led with poke.

kaelen.reason: Tank whose Winter's Pursuit lunge and Frostfall leap root targets, Rimefang stuns, and Rimeglass/Rimestorm apply Frostbite slows over an area; current tags kept.

kallari.reason: Shadow Walk camouflage and Shadow Dance dash reach an isolated target, then Death Mark and Guillotine's missing-health damage finish them; current diver, burst kept.

khaimera.reason: Ambush leaps onto a target, Invigorate cleanses and heals scaled by regen while Ancestral Fury's Rage adds regen and faster cooldowns, and Unleash plus Cull's suppress win one-on-ones; current tags kept.

kira.reason: Marksman who stacks Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy and shreds with Purge's lifesteal torrent, resetting Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills; current dps kept.

kwang.reason: Surge of the Heavens rushes in and, dashing into the thrown Blade from Judgement of the Heavens, knocks up and stuns, Fury of the Heavens teleports to the Blade, and Strike of the Heavens' Energized basics cut cooldowns in brawls; added engage.

legion.reason: K-75 Storm Rifle with Rally Point's infinite ammo deals sustained damage, Orbital Sanction and Saturation Charge mines zone an area, and Rally Point heals allies every second and knocks enemies back; added peel and led with dps.

lt-belica.reason: Seismic Assault stun and Void Drone mana drain set up Void Bomb into Neural Disruptor's missing-mana/health execute with a kill reset; current control, burst kept.

maco.reason: Maco Gift! heals and speeds allies and Maco Fly! shields him, while Maco Sparkle! and the charged Maco Strike! push-and-stun lock enemies down at range; added control.

morigesh.reason: Curse cashes in the Mark on a Pestilence-stacked target as her burst finisher, and Mark's heal (bigger per Pestilence stack) plus Swarm's damage-dealt heal and damage reduction keep her alive through trades; added sustain to the current burst.

mourn.reason: Abduct pulls enemies in and Beguile's charged AoE Mesmerize opens fights (engage/control), while Contagion heals allies and grants them armor (peel); dropped sustain, since his self-heal is only Extract and his healing is mainly for allies, and added control and peel.

murdock.reason: Long Arm of the Law is an unlimited-range, terrain-piercing snipe and Charged shots get extra range (poke), while Hot Pursuit stacking attack speed with resets on takedown drives sustained marksman damage (dps); unchanged.

muriel.reason: Maintainer ruling 2026-11-08: Reversal of Fortune flies Muriel to an ally to save them, so it is peel, not engage; the landing knock-up is incidental. Her identity is ally shields and heals (peel).

narbash.reason: Song of My People and March! give allies healing or speed (peel), Crash Bang Boom! stacks slows into an AoE Mesmerize and ends with a knock up and stun, and Thunk knocks back and stuns (control/engage); added control to the current engage and peel and put the aura first.

neon.reason: Final Thread's recast bomb scales with missing health after an Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerize and L.I.N.X true damage (burst), and L.I.N.X and Data Burst hit from range (poke); unchanged.

phase.reason: Telekinetic Link shares power, Essence Catalyst healing and Hyperflux with an ally (and can pull them to safety), while Psychic Flare's blind and Energy Lance's stacking root stop divers; still pure peel, unchanged.

rampage.reason: Pounce leaps in and shatters a held Boulder Throw for an area stun (diver/engage, longer leap in Behemoth), and Behemoth's bonus health and regen per nearby enemy plus King of the Jungle regen heal him through fights (sustain); unchanged.

renna.reason: Soulfire waves and the Abyssal Rift singularity deal damage across a fight (dps), Mortal Coil pulls enemies together and Stupor Mesmerizes them (control), and Mortal Coil heals her for damage dealt (sustain); added control and sustain to the current dps.

revenant.reason: Fate's fourth shot always crits for missing-health damage and Obliterate focuses Scar-Marked targets (burst/dps), and Reckoning banishes one enemy into the Nether Realm with him while stealing their power, forcing a one-on-one (duelist); added duelist.

riktor.reason: A Warden/Tank whose Riplash pulls a hero in, Shock Therapy breaks shields and silences, and Skewer suppresses everyone in front, so he starts fights and locks down divers; unchanged.

scarlett.reason: First Intent and Minueta dash her in (diver), Swan Song restrains the target while she is unstoppable and Ablaze Minueta's final stab scales with missing health (burst), and First Intent shields plus Ashen Vow's max-health Cindara hits win extended trades (duelist); added burst and duelist.

serath.reason: Ascend and Heaven's Fury (untargetable dash onto the target) take her past the front line, and Chastise attack resets plus Heresy's attack speed and burn delete a target, with Fallen Grace resets on takedown; unchanged.

sevarog.reason: A Tank whose Phantom Rush glides through enemies and fears them (engage), with Subjugate chaining enemies in a zone and stunning leavers and Colossal Blow knocking back (control); unchanged.

shinbi.reason: Two Rushing Beat charges dash through units onto the backline, and Line Tempo and Circle Rhythm hits build Track so All-Kill! drops a wolf pack on every hero she damaged; unchanged.

skylar.reason: Hypercharge's ramping on-hit damage and Air Assault's hover with extra range and missiles make her a sustained marksman; Atomiser's missing-health finish is a single ult and not her identity, so unchanged.

sparrow.reason: Heightened Senses attack speed, Relentless max-health stacks and the Inner Fire barrage give sustained damage (dps), and the charged Piercing Shot passes through all units and terrain from long range (poke); added poke.

steel.reason: A Tank/Warden who Bull Rushes in unstoppable to stun and knock back and Shield Slams for a knock up and stun (engage), and whose Force Shield destroys enemy projectiles and Shield Bash stuns divers (peel); unchanged.

terra.reason: Wild Rush is an unstoppable charge that stuns the first hero it hits (engage, but it stops on the front line, not past it), and Ruthless Assault's cooldown refunds, Empowered max-health strikes and Unstoppable Force's cleanse, armor and tenacity win extended trades (duelist); dropped diver and added duelist.

the-fey.reason: Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zone areas and Fly Trap pulls in and stuns every attached hero (control), and Harvest Nettles' ranged orb, stacking damage on repeat hits with mana refunds, chips from range (poke); added poke.

twinblast.reason: Gunslinger's triple-shot basic attacks after each ability, Vaporize's on-hit projectiles and Ventilate's barrage, kept alive by Rocket Dash, make him a sustained marksman; unchanged.

valmont.reason: Bloodbound attack speed with Lilith's Hemophagia strikes and Rupture blades deal damage across a fight (dps), and the toggled Exsanguinate bats return to heal him (sustain); unchanged.

wraith.reason: Knock, Knock! is a long-range snipe that deals bonus max-health damage on Peekaboo!-Marked targets (poke/burst pick), and Back It Up! drags a fleeing hero back into range; unchanged.

wukong.reason: Pole Vault leaps in and Windsurge dashes (diver), and Pole Vault's attack speed, Cyclebreaker's damage reduction and stun, and the clones spawned by 84000 Hairs stacks win skirmishes (duelist); added duelist.

yin.reason: Windburn's third-hit max-health damage and healing, Rising Storm attack-speed stacks, and Backlash and Quelling Gale stopping enemy projectiles make her a one-on-one skirmisher, while Lash Kick dashes her in; same tags, reordered so duelist (her archetype) leads.

yurei.reason: Severance dashes reset on Soul Rip targets and Anima Burst leaps her in (diver), and Whispering Echoes then Soulstorm's pull and Severance reset chain her damage onto one target (burst); unchanged.

zarus.reason: Coliseum leaps onto a hero and walls them in with doubled Gladiator stacks (duelist/diver), and Spear of Nyr's bonus damage below 20% health finishes them (burst); dropped sustain, since Gladiator's per-stack heal is minor, and put duelist first.

zinx.reason: Infuse heals allies more the lower they are and Neural Regenesis revives an ally (peel), and Ricochet stuns a chain of enemies while Bad Medicine's pool slows twice (control); added control.

rulings.2026-11-08: Muriel is peel, not engage. Grux is a diver.
